focus_areas: Edge sharpness and depth separation between yellow tail and background rock
Texture consistency of black scales vs yellow scales
Anatomical correctness and continuity of fin placement
Spatial grounding of the fish within the reef environment
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the black and yellow sections of the fish. AI models often blur this line or create unnatural gradients. Inspect the eye for realistic reflection highlights; flat or dead eyes are a common artifact. Crucially, verify that the 'rounded tail' does not merge into the background rocks using depth cues. Ensure the dorsal fin is a single continuous structure without breaks or extra segments.
image_description: A single Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming in a marine environment. The fish exhibits the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. It is positioned near a textured rocky reef structure with blue water in the background.
